settings.heading: Shipping & Delivery
settings.intro: We want your order to reach you safely, quickly, and beautifully. From the moment you place an order, your jewellery is carefully packed and on its way — here’s everything you need to know.
settings.closing_text: Still have a question? We’d love to help.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.answer: Yes — we offer free standard shipping on all UK orders over £50. Orders under £50 ship for a flat rate of [CONFIRM: £3.50].

settings.question: How long will my order take to arrive?
settings.answer:
UK standard delivery takes 3–5 working days. Orders placed before [CONFIRM: 2pm] on a working day are dispatched the same day.

We’ll send you a tracking link by email as soon as your order is on its way.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer:
[CONFIRM: Yes, we ship to Europe and select international destinations. European delivery typically takes 5–7 working days, and international orders 7–14 working days. Shipping costs are calculated at checkout.]

[CONFIRM: Please note that international orders may be subject to local customs duties or import taxes, which are the responsibility of the recipient.]

settings.question: Will I receive tracking information?
settings.answer: Yes. Once your order has been dispatched, you’ll receive an email with a tracking link so you can follow your parcel’s journey.

settings.question: What happens if my order is delayed?
settings.answer: Occasionally, deliveries can take a little longer than expected — particularly during busy periods. If your order hasn’t arrived within the estimated timeframe, please get in touch at hello@daphneblue.co.uk and we’ll look into it straight away.
